cites.quote: Бракомъ сочетавшіеся въ 1911 году. | 34 | Апрѣля двадцать второго | Мартинъ Вильгельмъ Зирлакъ сынъ Петра (Martin Wilhelm Sirlak) / Эрна Смукулъ, дочь Дава (Erna Smukul) | 62
cites.translation: Married in 1911. No. 34, 22 April: Martin Wilhelm Sirlak, son of Pēteris; Erna [Emma] Smukul, daughter of Dāvis. Main register no. 62.
cites.note: Married 22 Apr 1911 Julian (= 5 May 1911 Gregorian). Groom Martin Wilhelm Sirlak, son of Pēteris; bride written 'Erna' (Эрна / Erna) Smukul, daughter of Dāvis (Дава). The register here is only the year's summary list (no., date, names, fathers, and a reference to no. 62 of the main register, which is not in this volume), so no ages, residence, witnesses or banns. 'Erna' is taken as a clerk's slip for Emma: same clerk writes 'Эмма' plainly at no. 27. Confirms Emma's father's name Dāvis (her US SS record: Dāvis Smukuls) and places the marriage eight months before Elvīra's birth, in the same congregation that baptised her. Corrects the memoir's 'married young': he was 27, she 26.
cites.why: [DNA evidence (private)] same congregation as Elvīra's 1912 baptism. Only the bride's given name differs (Erna vs Emma). Verified by the parent on the crop.
cites.as_recorded: Мартинъ Вильгельмъ Зирлакъ сынъ Петра (Martin Wilhelm Sirlak) / Эрна Смукулъ дочь Дава (Erna Smukul)

cites.title: Jaunrauna estate revision 1816, manor people
cites.repository: LVVA, via Raduraksti
cites.locator: LVVA f. 199, apr. 1, l. 376, image 31 (fol. 26); farm 29 on image 54 (fol. 49)
cites.quote: Weber Jahn, Ansch S., a. d. No. 29 | 32. | 37. / Sohn Dawe, nachhergeboren | ½ — Jahns Eheweib Masche, Ansch T. 41
cites.translation: Weaver Jahn, son of Ansis, from no. 29, 32 [in 1811], 37 [now]; son Dāvis, born since, ½. Jahn's wife Masche, daughter of Ansis, 41.
cites.note: 1816 revision (7th), manor people: weaver Jahn, son of Ansch (Ansis), from farm no. 29, aged 32 in 1811 and 37 in 1816 (b. c. 1779); son Dawe, born after 1811, ½. Wife Masche, daughter of Ansch, 41 (b. c. 1775); daughters Trine 16, Anne 14, Marri 10, Liese 5. No surname yet (surnames were assigned in Livonia c. 1822–1826). Without a surname, a second Jahn son of Ansch on the same estate leaves some doubt.

cites.title: Priekuļi (Freudenberg) soul revision 1857, XIX Gibboi farm, family 10/58
cites.repository: Latvian State Historical Archives (LVVA), via Raduraksti
cites.quote: XIX. Gibboi-Gesinde. | 10. | 58. | Jahns Söhne 1. Marz Gibboi Wirth | 34½. | 41½. / 2. Jahn Wirthsgehülfe[?] | 28. | 35. / dessen Sohn Marz | 1855 nachgeboren | 2. / 3. Dahw | 25½.
cites.translation: Farm XIX Ģiboļi. Family 10/58: Jahn's sons 1. Mārcis Gibboi, farmer, 34½ then, 41½ now; 2. Jānis, farmer's assistant[?], 28, 35; his son Mārcis, born 1855, 2; 3. Dāvis, 25½.
cites.note: The 1857 soul revision's column for the last revision (1850), XIX Gibboi farm, family 10: 'Jahns Söhne 1. Marz Gibboi' 34½, '2. Jahn' 28, '3. Dahw' 25½ (so b. c. 1816, 1822 and 1824/25): the sons of a Jahn, on this farm in 1850. Dahw has no age for 1857; the note beside him reads roughly 'by order of the Kameralhof of 18[?] … 1856, No. 652, transferred to Riga' [?]. The 1850 revision itself (f. 199/1/112) has not been read for this farm.
cites.why: Read at full size (Round 3). The three are the sons Mārcis (b. 1816), Jānis (b. 1822) and Dāvis (b. 1825) of Jānis Ģibols (1790–1847) × Masche in Raimonds's tree: the father's name and all three ages agree. The page names no mother.

leads.title: Two press/directory mentions of an Alberts Danenbergs: Lejasķuļi farm (1931 address book) and Rūjiena (fined, 1929)
leads.question: Danenbergs / Forstmanis (Arvīds's side)
leads.claim: One of these is Arvīds's father Alberts.

evidence_for.note: Alberts Danenbergs (identity unconfirmed): residence 1931 Lejasķuļi farm, parish unread (directory section marked 'c. R.'). 1931 farmers' and landowners' address book. Parish/district was not read; needs a page check.
evidence_for.quote: Danenbergs, Alberts, Lejasķuļos, c. R.
evidence_for.translation: Danenbergs, Alberts, at Lejasķuļi [farm]
evidence_for.why: Only an OCR snippet; the parish is unknown.

sources.title: entry Danenbergs, Alberts

evidence_for.note: Alberts Danenbergs (identity unconfirmed): residence 1929-12-16 Rūjiena area. Fined Ls 20 or 6 days' arrest by the justice of the peace of the 4th district of Valmiera county, with nine other men, for not observing the rules on societies and associations (Rūjienas Balss, 16 Dec 1929, p. 1, 'Sodīti:'). Rūjiena is the birthplace of Ede Kārkliņa née Danenberga (b. 1868, father Mārtiņš), so this may be a Vidzeme Danenbergs line rather than ours.
evidence_for.quote: — Walmeeras apriņķa 4. eezirkņa meerteesnesis sodijis par noteikumu neeewehroschanu atteezibā uſ beedribam un saweenibam: Hermani Bachu, Peteri Tenteri, Jahni Bailiti, Mikeli Lorenzi, Elmaru Upiti, Peteri Tenteri, Albertu Danenbergu, Karli Tschahkuri, Karli Alberingu un Jahni Kurpneeku, katru ar Ls 20.— jeb 6 deenam aresta.
evidence_for.translation: The justice of the peace of the 4th district of Valmiera county has fined, for not observing the rules on societies and associations: Hermanis Bahs, Pēteris Tenteris, Jānis Bailītis, Miķelis Lorencs, Elmārs Upītis, Pēteris Tenteris, Alberts Danenbergs, Kārlis Čakurs, Kārlis Alberings and Jānis Kurpnieks, each Ls 20 or 6 days' arrest.
evidence_for.why: One OCR mention; no age or parents.

sources.title: court news, 1929-12-16
sources.locator: Rūjienas Balss, Nr. 34 (16.12.1929), p. 1, 'Sodīti:' (periodika.lv issue 764462, article DIVL71)

evidence_against.note: Lejasķuļi: parish unread. Rūjiena: far from Tukums and Penkule, and the birthplace of Ede Kārkliņa née Danenberga (a Vidzeme line, lead ede-karklina-nee-danenberga), so probably another man.

leads.decider: The address book page (parish and district) for Lejasķuļi.

leads.title: Arvīds's birthplace: Tukums / Stūrmuiža / Auce-Vecauce / Penkule
leads.question: Danenbergs / Forstmanis (Arvīds's side)
leads.claim: He was born at Stūrmuiža (Stūri, Blīdene parish), Tukums district.

evidence_for.note: His own 1950 declaration of intention: 'Sturumuiza'; the 1996 DV obituary: Stūrmuižas pagasts.
evidence_for.quote: (5) I was born on Jan. 17, 1913 in Sturumuiza Latvia

sources.title: Declaration of Intention No. 134, Arvids Danenbergs, Mercer County Common Pleas, Celina, Ohio, 14 Aug 1950

evidence_for.note: His own 1950 declaration of intention: 'Sturumuiza'; the 1996 DV obituary: Stūrmuižas pagasts.
evidence_for.quote: Arvīds Fricis Danenbergs, dzimis 1913.g. 17. janvārī Tukuma apriņķa Stūrmuižas pagastā. Pēc 2.Jelgavas valsts ģimnāzijas beigšanas studē Lauksaimniecības Akadēmijā Jelgavā, ko beidz ar agronoma grādu. Strādā Talsu agronomiskā birojā. 1941.g. no Sv. Jāņa baznīcas Cēsīs uzsāk kopīgu ģimenes dzīvi ar farmaceiti Elvīru Širlaku. 1944.g. Arvīds ar sievu, 2 gadus vecu dēlu Pēteri un sievas māti Emmu Širlaku dodas bēgļu gaitās uz Vāciju. Tur turpina izglītību Štutgartes—Hohenheimas agrikultūras augstkolā, kur iegūst mākstera grādu agronomijā. 1949.g. izceļo uz ASV. … Miris pēkšņā nāvē auto katastrofā 1996. g. 19. februārī, atstājot sievu Elvīru, trīs bērnus — Pēteri, Kalvi, Līgu, 3 mazbērnus ASV, brāli Žani un vairākus radus Latvijā. Pārpelnots un pelnu urna nosūtīta uz Latviju.
evidence_for.translation: Arvīds Fricis Danenbergs, born 17 January 1913 in Stūrmuiža parish, Tukums district. After finishing the 2nd Jelgava State Gymnasium he studied at the Agricultural Academy in Jelgava, graduating as an agronomist. He worked at the Talsi agronomy bureau. In 1941, from St John's church in Cēsis, he began family life with the pharmacist Elvīra Širlaka [sic]. In 1944 Arvīds, his wife, their two-year-old son Pēteris and his wife's mother Emma Širlaka fled as refugees to Germany. There he continued his studies at the Stuttgart-Hohenheim agricultural college, earning a master's degree in agronomy. In 1949 he emigrated to the USA. … Died suddenly in a car accident on 19 February 1996, survived by his wife Elvīra, three children (Pēteris, Kalvis, Līga), 3 grandchildren in the USA, his brother Žanis and several relatives in Latvia. Cremated; the urn was sent to Latvia.

sources.title: Zudušie ASV: Miris Arvīds Danenbergs (in 'Ziņas un chronika')
sources.locator: Daugavas Vanagu Mēnešraksts, Nr.2 (01.04.1996), section beginning p. 46

evidence_against.quote: Arvīds Danenbergs, DV ap-bas Latvijas ciemā pie Garezerā valdes loc, 17. janv. atskatījās uz 70 mūža gadiem. Dzimis 1913. g. Vecauces pag. Beidzis LU lauksaimniecības fakultāti un strādāja par Talsu raj. agronomu. Ieradies ASV, 1949. g. viņš strādāja Ziemeļohaio lopu audzēšanas kooperatīvā, bet 1955. g. nopirka savu lauksaimniecību, ko turpina apsaimniekot.
evidence_against.translation: Arvīds Danenbergs, board member of the DV branch in the Latvian village at Garezers, turned 70 on 17 January. Born 1913 in Vecauce parish. Graduated from the agricultural faculty of the University of Latvia and worked as the Talsi district agronomist. Arriving in the USA in 1949, he worked at a northern Ohio livestock-breeding co-operative, and in 1955 bought his own farm, which he still runs.
